# awscc_transcribe_medical_vocabulary (Resource)

Resource type definition for AWS::Transcribe::MedicalVocabulary



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `language_code` (String) The language code of the vocabulary entries.
- `vocabulary_name` (String) The name of the medical vocabulary.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags associated with the medical vocabulary. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `vocabulary_file_uri` (String) The Amazon S3 location of the text file that contains the medical vocabulary.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the medical vocabulary.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_transcribe_medical_vocabulary.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the medical vocabulary

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_transcribe_medical_vocabulary.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_transcribe_medical_vocabulary.example "arn"
```
